page.title: Home
page.purpose: Give the operator the first useful view of Lighting Control and make the primary next action clear.

states.description: The dashboard shows the current service health and the next useful action.
The dashboard announces that health information is still loading.
No controllers are currently available; the operator sees the backend state, saved policy, and next recovery action.
Some controllers or zones are available while others are disconnected, unsupported, or not enrolled; each zone keeps its own result.
A failed refresh is shown while previously loaded state remains visible and is marked as last known.
Telemetry age and source health are visible; stale inputs use the configured static fallback without claiming physical output.
